data.one_liner: An enhanced fully async NoSQL database for Flutter and Dart applications.
data.what_it_does: Isar Plus is an enhanced fork of the original Isar NoSQL database providing high-speed storage, composite and multi-entry indexes, query modifiers, and JSON support. It features cross-platform capabilities including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux with persistent web storage via IndexedDB.
use_when: You need a fast, fully async NoSQL database for Flutter supporting multiple platforms including the web.
Your application requires complex queries, composite indexes, and multi-isolate support.
You want real-time inspection of database instances and collections using the Isar Inspector.
avoid_when: Your project relies on standard relational SQL features without needing a NoSQL approach.
You want to avoid code generation steps in your build pipeline.
strengths: Extremely fast performance and high scalability.
Fully asynchronous with parallel query operations and multi-isolate support.
Persistent web storage through IndexedDB integration for Flutter Web.
weaknesses: Requires code generation to build data models.
Unit tests require explicit initialization and single-threaded execution (`flutter test -j 1`).
data.setup_notes: Requires running build_runner for code generation and initializing Isar Core for native platforms or tests using `await Isar.initializeIsarCore(download: true)`.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a robust, reactive SQL database for Flutter with type-safe queries.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a traditional, lightweight SQLite database interface for mobile platforms.

alternatives.name: hive
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a lightweight key-value NoSQL database without complex indexing requirements.
